requirements_checked: SPEC §9 (auth gates on the two API actions)
spec_coverage.notes: All three assigned files match the spec text verbatim; every identifier they depend on was traced and confirmed. ROUTE (§5.1): config/routes.rb:266 adds `resource :ai_job_criteria, only: [:show, :create], controller: 'ai_job_criteria'` INSIDE `resources :jobs do` (block opens at routes.rb:224), alongside the other job-nested resources (bulk_channel_messages at :265). Singleton `resource` + explicit `controller:` matches §5.1 exactly; no other lines in routes.rb changed. CONTROLLER (§5.2): ai_job_criteria_controller.rb (new, 29 lines) subclasses Api::V1::BaseController. `show` → exists(current_organization.jobs.where(id: params[:job_id]), 'no job found') block → authorize job, :show? → render_one(job, Api::V1::JobAiJobCriteriaSerializer). `create` → same exists block → authorize job, :update? (the amended gate — matching, NOT a finding) → Flipper.enabled?(:AI_APPLICANT_SUMMARY, current_organization) gate with exact error 'AI summaries are not enabled for this organization.' → job.description.blank? guard with exact error 'This job needs a description before Plato can extract criteria. Add one in Job setup.' → job.extract_job_criteria_immediately(requesting_organization_user_id: current_organization_user.id) → render_one. Ordering (authorize → Flipper → blank → extract → render) matches §5.2 verbatim. Verified helper semantics: application_controller.rb:40 render_general_errors renders status :unprocessable_entity (422) — so both the Flipper and blank-description branches return 422 as §5.2 requires; application_controller.rb:52 exists yields obj.first (org-scoped AR relation); application_controller.rb:89 render_one renders status 200; base_controller.rb:23/27 define current_organization / current_organization_user; application_controller.rb:6 includes Pundit (authorize available). No params method — none needed (no body params; core rule 5 compliant). job_policy.rb:12-14 show? = hiring-team member OR admin; job_policy.rb:20-22/58-60 update? = on_hiring_team? = is_org_admin? || record.users.include?(user) — the adjudicated §9 gate. In-flight no-op is delegated to Job#extract_job_criteria_immediately (job.rb:730-739, in_progress/retrying guards), and create returns the current payload via render_one — matches §5.2 idempotent design. SERIALIZER (§5.3): job_ai_job_criteria_serializer.rb (new, 21 lines) subclasses ActiveModel::Serializer; attributes :criteria, :extracted_at, :status, :zero_criteria_failure. `criteria` = object.latest_succeeded_ai_job_criteria&.criteria and `extracted_at` = object.latest_succeeded_ai_job_criteria&.updated_at both read the LATEST SUCCEEDED row (job.rb:692-694: ai_job_criteria.status_succeeded.order(created_at: :desc).first). `status` = object.latest_ai_job_criteria&.status reads the LATEST row of ANY status (job.rb:688-690: ai_job_criteria.order(created_at: :desc).first) — nil when no rows exist. `zero_criteria_failure` = object.zero_criteria_extraction_failure? (job.rb:696-698: latest_ai_job_criteria&.zero_criteria_failure?). The latest-succeeded vs latest distinction required by §5.3 is present and correct. All four use safe navigation; no fabricated `|| false` / `|| []` fallbacks (core rule 10 / pipeline rule 13 satisfied). No scope creep in any of the three files: the diff for this area is exactly the two new files plus the single added route line.
